title: Electronics (smartphones, mobile phones & tablets)
legalBasis: Regulation (EU) 2023/1670 Art. 1(1) (ecodesign — smartphones, other mobile phones, cordless phones, slate tablets)
notes: In force for smartphones, other mobile phones, cordless phones & slate tablets since 2025-06-20 (repairability class A-E, durability, 7-year spare parts, OS updates). v1.2.0 (current) narrows productCategory to exactly these four Art. 1(1) device types — laptop/monitor/tv/server/router/charger/earphone/pcb/other are removed: none of them has a DPP obligation, in force or dated, under any EU instrument. v1.1.0 corrects repairabilityScore to the structured {overall, criteria} shape; v1.0.0 is kept for historical immutability (it incorrectly declared repairabilityScore as a bare number). retentionYears is assumed, not sourced: not covered by the 2026-07-28 citation pass that checked the other sectors — Reg. (EU) 2023/1670 and 2023/1669 have not been checked for a passport-retention figure.
